sentences.en: The food at this restaurant was only marginally better despite the price.
sentences.zh: 尽管价格较高，但这家餐厅的食物质量仅仅稍微好了一点。

sentences.en: Her chances of winning marginally improved after her coach's advice.
sentences.zh: 在教练的建议之后，她获胜的机会稍微增加了一些。

sentences.en: The new policy will marginally reduce our operating costs.
sentences.zh: 新政策将略微降低我们的运营成本。

senses.zh: 少量地；最低限度地；在栏外；在页边
